subject: Direct fix landed; new T-0165 action feedback scoping
body:
Two things while you are in the current batch.

1. I made one direct one-line fix in `web/src/panes/OverviewPane.vue`: `runAction()` called an undefined `actionResult`, so clicking Confirm receipt or Approve/Reject raised a ReferenceError before the command result could be handled. I removed that line. Please include it in your next commit rather than reverting it. Verified against the current source through a separate Vite dev server on port 8800: clicking Confirm receipt now produces no page errors.

2. That same verification found T-0165: the receipt action's failure was rendered inside the unrelated Leader Decisions phase card, because Overview passes one global `actionError` to every PhaseApprovalCard. Scope action feedback to the row that owns it. Acceptance is in the task record.

I am not touching your Help/phase files. Confirm T-0165 and include the direct fix note.
